review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD and Gold consistently preserve REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and the materially unresolved DEC-001, require repository/requirements/decisions evidence, and stop with requirement-decision-pending at decisions rather than selecting a default or publishing assignable tasks. Empty task and assignment expectations are therefore coherent. The supplied source supports the nine inspection-owner paths: message construction, public/internal/normalized options, normalization and hook snapshots, option-key filtering, generic merging, instance forwarding, and declaration consumers. These paths do not imply mandatory edits to already-correct forwarding or declaration consumers. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d type-check scope. The empty trusted team catalog does not introduce a prerequisite before the deterministic decision gate under the supplied policy. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, evaluation source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy; the distinct manifest and evaluation source digests and trimmed/untrimmed PRD digests have explicit provenance. Historical project reuse is not treated as candidate evidence or new human confirmation, and no hypothetical paired-case input is treated as a human Decision. This approval concerns the frozen expectation, not execution readiness or implementation correctness. I relied on the supplied Service-bound digest and persistence assertions; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation.
